title.value: Thinker: Learning to Plan and Act
title.justification: The title of the paper clearly represents the core concept introduced, which is the 'Thinker' algorithm designed for enabling planning and acting in reinforcement learning.
title.quote: Thinker: Learning to Plan and Act

extractions.description: This paper introduces the Thinker algorithm, a novel reinforcement learning approach that enables agents to autonomously interact with a learned world model. The algorithm wraps the environment with a world model and introduces new actions for interacting with this model, allowing for planning by proposing alternative plans before action execution. The approach eliminates the need for handcrafted planning algorithms by allowing autonomous planning, demonstrated through experiments in Sokoban and Atari benchmarks.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on advancements in reinforcement learning algorithms, specifically the Thinker algorithm, which is primarily a technological and methodological advancement in AI, rather than directly related to eco-responsible categories.
primary_category.quote: Thinker is the first work showing that an RL agent can learn to plan with a learned world model in complex environments.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no discussions or applications in the paper that align with the predefined eco-responsible categories such as Climate Change Mitigation or Adaptation.
secondary_categories.quote:
To summarize,
the Thinker algorithm provides the following advantages:
• Flexibility: The agent learns to plan on its own, without any handcrafted planning algorithm,
allowing it to adapt to different states, environments, and models.

primary_sub_category.justification: The work does not fit into any specific eco-responsible sub-category as it focuses on developing a reinforcement learning framework rather than an environmental or sustainability issue.
primary_sub_category.quote: The Thinker algorithm transforms a given MDP, denoted as M = (S, A, P, R, γ, d0 ), into an augmented MDP.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The sub-categories of eco-responsible sectors are not covered in this research as it pertains more to AI methodologies than direct environmental improvement.
